```markdown
## What this issue is about
This issue discusses the development of the Quanta Toolbar, a new feature for the Volto CMS User Interface. It aims to provide a better way for users to interact with blocks, improving functionality and usability.

## What needs to be done
We need to implement a new set of components for the Quanta Toolbar. This feature should be developed as experimental in Volto 16 and could become the default once feedback and initial issues are addressed. The implementation must avoid heavy reliance on SemanticUI to allow for better flexibility in the future.

## Helpful background
The Quanta Toolbar addresses limitations in the current toolbar related to moving and deleting blocks. The implementation will improve user experience, especially in handling additional controls. For reference, see the proposed initial implementation in PR #3161. Mockups can be found in the provided Figma links.

## Good first steps
1. Review the initial implementation in PR #3161.
2. Familiarize yourself with the mockups in the Figma links.
3. Reach out to @sneridagh for guidance and collaboration on this PLIP.
4. Be prepared to document the feature thoroughly once developed.
```
